thumbnail.question: Which YouTube thumbnail, all in the launch-reel look: A (band in the doorway + stacked title), B (Aoi close-up + big title) or C (all four members in cards + title)?
thumbnail.recommendation: C for the MV: every member, readable at list size, and no reveal, so it also works before MV day. A shows the doorway reveal (MV day only). B is the strongest single face.

youtube.title: Shamanic Resin - Hasta La Vista Maybe (Official Music Video)
youtube.description:
Four friends who used to sing with their breath held in a tiny room kick the door open. Shamanic Resin - "Hasta La Vista Maybe".

New album Real Dream, out now.
The whole GeekFon Society catalog, and the making of this video: geekfon.ai

@GeekFon
youtube.altered_content: Yes. YouTube only requires it for realistic content and this is animation, but canon-lola-social-seat makes AI disclosure positioning, so we label it anyway.
youtube.visibility: Private until the MV reveal date (after Real Dream, date not set), then Public

end_screen.placement: Lower half of the end card, under the 'Out now' pill. Keep the title block and the Real Dream cover clear; check in the Studio preview.

teaser_1.script: Hi, it's LoLA. Shamanic Resin used to sing with their breath held, in a tiny room. That's about to change. The new single is called Hasta La Vista Maybe. The door is about to open. Stay close.

teaser_2.script: LoLA again. Weeks of work went into the Hasta La Vista Maybe video, and GeekFon members get to watch it come together first: the storyboards, the early cuts, all of it. Join at geekfon.ai and see how it was made.

voice.cleaning: Sean 2026-11-19: clean the first and last half second. Trim to the speech (hum, blips and clicks outside the cut), 20 ms fade in, 120 ms fade out, 70 Hz high-pass, loudnorm -16 LUFS. Every trimmed line checked word for word with speech-to-text.
voice.takes_not_used: t1-single last take said 'was called Asta'; t1-close take 2 'cros'; t2-again take 2 'Mola'; t2-join takes 1-2 'Join us at'.

teaser_mix.proof: Lip check: 2/7 closures Wan alone, sync-3 closes every bilabial when the frames around each sound are checked (maybe 3.00-3.15 s, room 6.05-6.20 s). STT on the final mix: every word back except ElevenLabs hears 'Rezzy' for Resin and 'baby' for Maybe (teaser 2); it hears the same on the voice-only line, and Whisper hears both right, so not the mix. Loudness -15.9 / -16.4 LUFS. 17.1 s and 19.6 s.
